record_kind: negative experiment lesson; not a motor policy
hypothesis: Phase/contact and action-start sampling improves a small tool-translation model over equal-size uniform sampling.

applicability.input: 293D padded privileged simulator state and retrospective executed-control summary
applicability.target: one-step held-tool translation delta; not robot actions

reusable_lessons.condition: Claiming an experience-selection benefit with more data than a baseline
reusable_lessons.guidance: Use an equal-count uniform-supplement comparator; added-data gains alone do not identify selection quality.

reusable_lessons.condition: Applying this exact phase/start sampling rule in these profiles
reusable_lessons.guidance: It lost to uniform across all three training seeds; do not promote it as an improvement.

reusable_lessons.condition: Using data that pass timing/model-state replay checks
reusable_lessons.guidance: Replay consistency does not establish contact-quality eligibility. Preserve high-force failures and their labels.

reusable_lessons.condition: Proposing a learned dynamics replacement for a simple predictor
reusable_lessons.guidance: Keep constant-velocity and train-fitted linear baselines; the constant-velocity model outperformed these MLPs.
